#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;

    std::vector<int> digits;
    while (m > 0) {
        int d = m % w;
        m /= w;
        if (d > w / 2) {
            d = w - d;
            m++;
        }
        digits.push_back(d);
    }

    for (int d : digits) {
        if (d > 1) {
            std::cout << "NO" << std::endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    std::cout << "YES" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
